note: This repairs genotype coverage before any candidate list is generated or frozen. TrpB is still not classified as pristine blind evidence because the full source was accidentally opened by a tool after preregistration.
reason: The preregistered contiguous row windows were found, from genotype identities alone, to cover only one amino-acid state at position 1 because the source table is lexicographically ordered. That makes the visible design non-representative independently of any fitness outcome.

replacement_visible_selection.rule: Enumerate all 20^4 genotypes in source-table order; compute FNV1a32('LIGHTNING_TRPB_V4|'+variant); sort ascending by (hash, variant); take first 588.
